passages.text: Our community centre starts a cooking programme for families on Saturday mornings. In the first lesson, each group receives one kilogram of flour for two small recipes. The leader asks us to read both recipes before we begin. Some of the flour is for bread, and the rest is for simple biscuits. My father measures the first part while I write labels for the bowls. We keep the bowls separate so that we do not use all the flour in one recipe. At the end, every family takes home something made together.

parallelText.zh: 第一节课上，每组收到一千克面粉，用来尝试两个小食谱。

parallelText.en: The leader asks us to read both recipes before we begin.
parallelText.zh: 负责人让我们动手前先读两个食谱。

parallelText.en: Some of the flour is for bread, and the rest is for simple biscuits.
parallelText.zh: 一部分面粉用来做面包，其余用来做简单的饼干。

parallelText.en: My father measures the first part while I write labels for the bowls.
parallelText.zh: 爸爸量第一份面粉，我给碗写标签。

parallelText.en: We keep the bowls separate so that we do not use all the flour in one recipe.
parallelText.zh: 我们把碗分开，以免在一个食谱里用光所有面粉。

parallelText.en: At the end, every family takes home something made together.
parallelText.zh: 最后，每个家庭都带回了共同制作的食物。

passages.text: Grandfather and I make a small boat from a piece of light wood. We carry it to a shallow pond where the surface is smooth and still. I hold the boat near the edge while Grandfather checks its little sail. When he is ready, I release the boat and move my hands away. A gentle wind carries it slowly towards the other side. We walk along the bank and watch without touching it. Grandfather lifts it out with a long stick, and we plan a second journey.

parallelText.en: Grandfather and I make a small boat from a piece of light wood.
parallelText.zh: 我和祖父用一块轻木头做了一条小船。

parallelText.en: We carry it to a shallow pond where the surface is smooth and still.
parallelText.zh: 我们把它带到一个浅池塘边，水面平滑而安静。

parallelText.en: I hold the boat near the edge while Grandfather checks its little sail.
parallelText.zh: 祖父检查小船帆时，我在水边扶着船。

parallelText.en: When he is ready, I release the boat and move my hands away.
parallelText.zh: 他准备好后，我放开小船，把手移开。

parallelText.en: A gentle wind carries it slowly towards the other side.
parallelText.zh: 轻风让小船缓缓向对岸漂去。

parallelText.en: We walk along the bank and watch without touching it.
parallelText.zh: 我们沿岸走着观察，没有碰它。

parallelText.en: Grandfather lifts it out with a long stick, and we plan a second journey.
parallelText.zh: 祖父用长棍把船挑起，我们计划再让它航行一次。
